scope: Offline re-analysis of retained actual-owner traces only; no new timing, profiling, browser, process-offload or service-state experiment.
limitations: Wall minus thread CPU includes scheduling/GIL, I/O/locks, runtime/GC and instrumentation effects; it is not a measured GIL-wait counter.
Small negative wall-minus-thread-CPU values are retained; coarse CPU accounting/clock granularity prevents interpreting millisecond differences as exact wait time.
Nested stages are inclusive and must not be summed; known CPU spans are not a decomposition of elapsed time.
Monitor parent is http.monitor, not monitor.heartbeat. Exact HTTP endpoint and initiating client are not identified by this retained record.
A root with no dropped spans does not prove that every competing process/thread/request was captured.
Wave groups are observational and have different actual-owner/background activity; no causal speedup or population p95 is inferred.
Process isolation benefits, IPC costs, memory bounds and shutdown behavior remain unmeasured proposal work.
